# MultifractalWavefunction

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Wavefunctions that exhibit non-uniform, scale-invariant fluctuations across multiple length scales, typical of critical phases in quasiperiodic systems. Multifractality can be harnessed for robust, distributed information storage and processing in TCC/iNEST architectures, mimicking neural-like complexity.
